description.en: A one-plugin index for dsh-crash-lore. Add this URL as an index source in Plugins → Discover.
description.zh: dsh-crash-lore 的单插件索引。在「插件 → 发现 → 索引源」里添加这个地址即可。

description.en: Mines the host's real crash logs into 23 hard constraints (event callbacks must catch their own errors, one missing required config stops boot, a client entry that never activates fails the whole boot), runs a static preflight on a plugin source directory before install — 33 structural checks including node --check, duplicate patch ids, ESM require, and the mandatory tools.register output contract — and, when the host crashes repeatedly, quarantines the culprit with a reversible backup instead of hand-editing the profile. A clean directory exits 0; fatal or boot findings exit 1.
description.zh: 把宿主真实崩溃日志沉淀成 23 条硬约束（事件回调必须自己兜住异常、一个必填配置缺失就起不来、client 入口没激活会让 boot 整体失败），装插件前对源码目录跑静态预检——33 项结构检查，含 node --check、patch 同 id 重复、ESM 里写 require、以及 tools.register 必须声明 output 的契约——宿主反复崩溃时用可撤销的备份隔离元凶，而不是手改 profile。目录干净退出码 0，有致命/起不来项退出码 1。
